title: Tolerances in microfluidic master molds: a comparison of 3D printing and micromilling
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19437-19448
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00916F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Daniel Chavarria, Immanuel Ojetola, Maria L. Russotti, Alexis K. Yates, Ethan S. Lippmann
This work explores differences between 3D printing and micromilling fabrication tolerances in microfluidic master molds. Characterization was done using profilometry, low-flow splitting, and gelatin microsphere assays.
